title: Engineered TYK2 dependence enables myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonism
title_zh: 工程化的TYK2依赖实现髓系选择性IL-10受体激动
abstract: Abstract Interleukin-10 (IL-10) is a central anti-inflammatory cytokine that suppresses immune responses in myeloid cells but can also activate T cells, limiting its therapeutic use in chronic inflammatory diseases owing to narrow efficacy windows and dose-limiting toxicities 1–5 . Here we show that myeloid and T cells differ in their dependence on JAK-family kinase pairing for IL-10 signalling and function. We took advantage of this differential kinase dependence to engineer a tetravalent nanobody-based myeloid-selective IL-10 receptor agonist (msIL-10R agonist) that fully recapitulates IL-10’s potent suppression of monocytes, macrophages and dendritic cells while avoiding stimulation of T cells. Cryo-electron microscopy structural analysis reveals a distinct receptor cross-linking geometry of the msIL-10R agonist compared with native IL-10 family cytokines. This tetravalent architecture renders signalling strictly TYK2-dependent and highly sensitive to IL-10Rα and IL-10Rβ receptor abundance, thereby conferring selective activity in myeloid cells. This msIL-10R agonist reduces inflammation in humanized mouse models of lipopolysaccharide challenge, delayed-type hypersensitivity and colitis. A humanized version exhibits IgG-like pharmacokinetics, sustained receptor occupancy and durable myeloid suppression up to 30 days without T cell activation or haematological toxicities in non-human primates. These findings establish a geometry-based strategy for achieving cell-type-selective cytokine signalling and identify the msIL-10R agonist as a therapeutic candidate for myeloid-driven inflammatory diseases, including inflammatory bowel diseases.
abstract_zh: 摘要 白细胞介素-10（IL-10）是一种核心抗炎细胞因子，可抑制髓系细胞中的免疫反应，但也可激活T细胞，这限制了其在慢性炎症性疾病中的治疗用途，因为其疗效窗口狭窄且剂量限制性毒性1–5。在此，我们展示了髓系细胞和T细胞在IL-10信号和功能方面对JAK家族激酶配对的依赖性不同。我们利用这种差异的激酶依赖性，工程化了一种四价纳米体基髓系选择性IL-10受体激动剂（msIL-10R激动剂），该激动剂完全再现了IL-10对单核巨噬细胞和树突状细胞强大抑制作用，同时避免刺激T细胞。冷冻电镜结构分析揭示了msIL-10R激动剂与原生IL-10家族细胞因子相比具有独特的受体交叉连接几何结构。这种四价架构使得信号严格依赖TYK2，且对IL-10Rα和IL-10Rβ受体丰度高度敏感，从而赋予了髓系细胞选择性活性。该msIL-10R激动剂在人源化小鼠模型中减轻了脂多糖挑战、延迟型超敏反应和结肠炎的炎症。人源化版本表现出类IgG的药代动力学、持续的受体占用和长达30天的持续髓系抑制，而无需T细胞激活或血液学毒性，在非人类灵长类动物中表现良好。这些发现确立了一种基于几何结构的实现细胞型选择性细胞因子信号的策略，并确定msIL-10R激动剂作为髓系驱动性炎症性疾病（包括炎症性肠病）的治疗候选物。
